question: Which categories of items are included among the offerings to be presented?
premises: Garments, ornaments, and similar items are mentioned.
Eatables and drinkables are also mentioned.
The items are presented as those which may be offered.
inference: The offerings include garments, ornaments, and similar things, as well as eatables and drinkables.
uncertainties: The governing verb for these items is supplied by the following verse.
plain_english: Garments, ornaments, and so on, and whatever eatables and drinkables there are.
